text:
Maya Patel: quick non-work note  who else noticed the seagull photobomb at 11:03? :bird:
Devin Cho: yes!! I thought my wifi was glitching at first lol
Samir Singh: it almost stole my granola bar. nearly inducted as a contractor. :sweat_smile:
Olga Petrov: the bird stared straight into the camera like it had slide feedback 7
Maya Patel: synchronized yawn at 11:04 = peak company culture moment :yawning_face:
Devin Cho: if a seagull approves, we ship the feature. official policy? :thumbsup:
Samir Singh: also, post-all-hands: can we start a plant rota? I'll do Thursdays. :seedling:
Olga Petrov: done. I'll take the fern (succulents are low-effort, promise)
Maya Patel: I'll be on cactus duty. zero drama. :ok_hand:
Devin Cho: happy to cover weekend check-ins. won't serenade them... maybe.
LunchBot: heads-up: leftover everything bagels in kitchen 50 first-come-first-served :bagel:
Samir Singh: can we get a "Seagull Cameo" badge? I want one. :trophy:
Olga Petrov: HR, please advise on feathered contractor policies. :raised_hand:
Maya Patel: motion to add :seagull_stamp: emoji in #general. all in favor?
Devin Cho: seconded. i'll sketch pixel art this weekend.
BuildBot: deploys/2026-03-23 11:05  all systems green :white_check_mark:
Samir Singh: great energy today y'all. tiny chaos, big mood. :sparkles:
Maya Patel: see you at the bagels and the plant sign-up sheet :wave:
